Wake up. They want you to believe this is just some clumsy paperwork error coming out of court documents, but look closer at what they are admitting. The lawyers for ICE were caught providing false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. Do you really think that was an accident? This is a coordinated trap, meticulously designed to lure in individuals seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts. 

And then look at the cover story they are spinning to protect themselves. Federal prosecutors now claim that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year did not authorize the arrests, even though they had previously cited that same memo to justify them. They are changing their tune because the script got exposed. They knew exactly what they were doing with that memo all along. It is all part of the hidden agenda to maintain total control and manipulate the narrative from the shadows.
